details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses the printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

**Heavy Frame — Passive:** Stability 1; an explicit creature trait, not a bonus from size.

**Weakness:** Fire damage suppresses Knit Flesh until its next recovery.

**Knit Flesh:** At turn end, recover 3 HP if above 0, unless it took fire damage since its previous turn end. Dies at 0; cannot regrow from death.

**Healing:** Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

**Senses:** Ordinary sight and hearing.

**Signs:** Bones and carefully sorted toll coins lie beneath the span.

**Purpose:** Eat regularly and be treated as the bridge’s owner.

**Tactics and retreat:** Push victims from the span; regenerate while bargaining; flee actual fire.

**Counterplay and conversation:** Bring fire, fight away from the drop, or pay a fair toll with enforceable terms.

**Habitat:** Bridge; river · **Communication:** Common and Giant

**Loot:** 45 coins in the toll box, plus belongings that may have living owners.

**Summoning:** Ineligible.

## Design notes — not needed during play

**ID:** creature-bridge-troll


**Category:** Giant · **Role:** Regenerating brute · **CV:** 24

### Creature-roll reference

| Attack | Attribute | Attack modifier | Weak attack | Standard attack | Strong attack |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bridge club | Brawn | 1 Boon | 3 physical damage. | 5 physical damage. Push 1. | 7 physical damage. Push 2. |

The incoming attack names the defense attribute; use the six values above. Same targeting, costs and limits apply in either perspective. No opposed second roll.


### CV worksheet

**Difficulty rationale:** No innate attack modifier; armor, cover and chosen actions provide its defenses. Its dangerous attack imposes defense Banes.

**Reference damage:** 3/5/7

**Reference type:** physical

**Expected targets:** 1

**Utility factor:** 1.3

**Regeneration per turn:** 3

Reference I=4.000, O=4.596. CV uses the [seed worksheet](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/9bc9b4fe3256e68880b92c45facf0f25b98a1ea3/design/bestiary/encounters.md); action choices, Stability and control are not simulated. Recalibration remains required.

**Ability sources:** [driving blow](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/9bc9b4fe3256e68880b92c45facf0f25b98a1ea3/design/monster-abilities/driving-blow.md), [knit flesh](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/9bc9b4fe3256e68880b92c45facf0f25b98a1ea3/design/monster-abilities/knit-flesh.md).
